name: 80487 · Steamboat Spr, CO
findings: ZIP 80487 (Steamboat Spr) has 71 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80487 (Steamboat Spr) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 80487 (Steamboat Spr) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).
